texts: good. the denial covers the whole ruling-on-private-matters bundle while the Council itself is still recorded outside it.
good. both marriages and fishing disputes come through as standing facts about village custom.
good. "all" becomes a fireable rule handing the Council every Keeper matter, with the quantifier word itself recorded.
good. a plain habitual event, with "stations" left as the kind rather than as one specific set.
good. same clean shape, with the investitures kept as a kind and still recorded as a kind of investiture.
good. the permission sits on the Council, and capitalized "Keepers" is read as the kind word rather than as a name for one particular body.
good. the permission sits on the ordering, and the commanded burning is reified with the Keeper as its agent and no claim that it happened.

mixed: "rarely" is recorded, but a one-off subject like the Council gives the frequency nowhere licensed to sit, so the parse improvised a weakened bundle for the ordering while leaving the burning itself asserted at full strength beside it. Give the rarity a range of cases to quantify by making the object a bare plural: "The Council rarely orders Keepers to burn wintergloss."
